node.statement: Approximate-algebra application. For the same arbitrary input and the same canonical tilde-Phi,A,star, the conclusions 0<=eta<=eta_A and ||Phi^2-Phi||_cb<=eta permit application of lem-routef-ai-defect-linearization. Hence the inherited operator-space norms, involution, and unit together with star make A an extended epsilon_AI(eta)-C*-algebra and epsilon_AI(eta)<=C_A*eta. Moreover eta<=1/8 implies 1-4eta lies in [1/2,1], so r=(3/2)((1-4eta)^(-1/2)-1)>=0 and therefore epsilon_AI(eta)=max{r,20eta+2((1+r)^5-1),3r-r^2}>=0. Together with radius extraction, 0<=epsilon_AI(eta)<=C_A*eta<=epsilon_E.
